maintained_economic_closure.welfare_population: representative workers only; domestic capitalists and foreigners receive zero direct welfare weight
maintained_economic_closure.domestic_capital_ownership: segmented domestic capitalists own all domestic capital; government and foreigners cannot buy it
maintained_economic_closure.government_risky_asset: one external international claim, not domestic public equity
maintained_economic_closure.international_pricing_closure: infinitesimal price-taking domestic government with a residual foreign counterparty; domestic positions do not change sigma_I=lambda_I or beta_I
maintained_economic_closure.adoption_assumption: weakly higher globally optimized output under adoption is maintained over the numerical region
maintained_economic_closure.firm_branch_assumption: interior smooth full-specialisation branch is maintained and checked locally, not globally selected by this solve
maintained_economic_closure.safe_asset_convention: signed residual safe position equals public net worth minus risky position
